# Real output of
#   zfs get -H -o name,property,value,source mountpoint,canmount -r rpool
# on the Proxmox VE 8.4 test VM (ZFS 2.2.7), root on rpool/ROOT/pve-1.
# This is the layout the /etc incident came from: a dataset created under
# rpool/ROOT/pve-1 inherits a path below /.
rpool	mountpoint	/rpool	default
rpool	canmount	on	default
rpool/ROOT	mountpoint	/rpool/ROOT	default
rpool/ROOT	canmount	on	default
rpool/ROOT/pve-1	mountpoint	/	local
rpool/ROOT/pve-1	canmount	on	default
rpool/data	mountpoint	/rpool/data	default
rpool/data	canmount	on	default
rpool/var-lib-vz	mountpoint	/var/lib/vz	local
rpool/var-lib-vz	canmount	on	default
